whoItsFor: Developers and AI practitioners who want a shared, searchable library of prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other chat models, and organizations that want to self-host a private prompt library.
useCases: Browse and copy community-written prompts for everyday AI tasks
Self-host a private, branded prompt library for a team or organization
Use prompts.chat as an MCP server or CLI to pull prompts into AI tools
